name: Venkat Suprabath Bitra
tagline: MS in Computer Science, Columbia University
bio: I'm a Master's student in Computer Science at Columbia University, where my work spans audio machine learning, mechanistic interpretability, and embedded computer vision. My thesis develops a VAE-based audio encoder with a Mamba-enhanced DDSP decoder for music synthesis and timbre transfer, alongside lightweight, self-supervised methods for pitch and voicing estimation.

Before Columbia, I completed an Integrated M.Tech in Computer Science at IIIT Bangalore, where my research ranged from moving object segmentation for SLAM to GAN-based 3D face editing and TinyML deployment of spectral analysis models. I've also spent time as a research intern at Adobe Research and the University of British Columbia, and published across venues in signal processing, computer vision, and computational biology.
